attchmntText: Albert David Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Albert David Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026. The Board considered, approved, and took on record the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. This approval was based on the recommendation of the Audit Committee and included the Statutory Auditor's Limited Review Report. The meeting commenced at 11:00 A.M. and concluded at 01:00 P.M. The financial statements are attached as Annexure A. The company filed this disclosure pursuant to Regulation 33 and other applicable provisions of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The announcement was signed by Lalit Lohia, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Albert David Limited has informed the Exchange about Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
desc: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
